text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- European Investment Bank grants loan of 34 million ECUs ($42.5 million) to finance water project in city of Marrakesh.
- Customs duty cut on imported long-life milk to 30 percent from 100 percent for month, to help meet demand during Ramadan.
- Libyan Prime Minister Abdelmajid al-Gu'ud to pay working visit to Morocco, aimed at boosting cooperation in all areas.
- Wave of freezing weather across Europe hits flights to Morocco. National airline Royal Air Maroc opens special lines to advise travellers.
- National Airports Office to start special training programmes for air traffic controllers, technicians and airport security officials.
- Casablanca court condemns to death young Moroccan who killed wife and walled up her body in their storeroom.
- Taxi drivers pursue strike in Rabat.
